newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway bonds weaken, waiting for Monday auction.
newsitem.headline: Norway bonds weaken, waiting for Monday auction.

text.p: 1400 GMT -- Norwegian bond yields rose and the spread to German bunds widened in thin trade as the market anxiously awaited for the government 2007 bond auction of 6.0 billion crowns on Monday. "There is very little activity today. Many are sitting on their positions until the auction," one dealer said. The crown was stable near 97.50 crowns on the inverse ECU index of European currencies and just below four crowns vs the mark.
* 2007 bond yield five points higher at 6.07 pct
* Norway over Bunds gap five points wider at 35 points
* Three-month eurokrone two points higher at 3.55 pct
